col1_Reason: Lack of expertise and knowledge of deforestation risks
col2_Please explain:
KZN has not undertaken a risk and vulnerability assessment on deforestation due to lack of the following:
i) A policy directive (provincial or national) requiring it (e.g. through DFFE, etc.).

ii) Climate risk frameworks that explicitly include forest cover and degradation (not just fire, floods) at sub-national scales.

iii) Donor funding or programme requirements (e.g. REDD+ or similar) that mandate risk assessments.

iv) Civil society / research institutions advocating for it, showing data gaps or threats.

v) Institutional capacity building: more GIS / remote sensing capacity, data sharing agreements, clear mandates between departments.
